description: Search adopted texts, committee documents, or plenary documents, then retrieve metadata and source-file links with mode get and document_id. Get accepts IDs from procedures, speeches, votes, questions and answers without a source family; parent_document_ids lead from subdivisions to parent files. Detail preserves adopted_document_ids, based_on_document_ids and public_register_ref; follow published document relations with mode get, while preserving ordinary missing-record and upstream-error outcomes for unavailable targets. Document relations never imply procedure links. Only adopted_texts supports text, title, sitting dates and related_process_id. Committee supports term but no year; plenary supports year but no term. Use euparl_list_reference topic document_types for family-specific work_type codes. Detail returns links, not extracted full text. Adopted texts expose at most 10000 search results; continue with page.next_offset when present, otherwise narrow supported filters.

document_id.description: Get-only canonical work ID, eli/dl/doc/ prefix or exact public URI; no family restriction.

language.description: Supported EU ISO-639-1 language, case-insensitive; default en; source text is never translated.

limit.description: Whole items requested; default 20, effective maximum 100 with notice.

mode.description: Default search discovers records; get requires document_id and rejects source and all search filters.

related_process_id.description: Adopted-texts-only procedure reference YYYY-NNNN, YYYY/NNNN(TYPE), known prefix or public URI.

sitting_date.description: Adopted-texts-only sitting date YYYY-MM-DD; start of range when sitting_date_end is supplied.

sitting_date_end.description: Adopted-texts-only inclusive range end YYYY-MM-DD; requires sitting_date and must not precede it.

source.description: Search-only family; omitted search defaults to adopted_texts. Omit entirely in get mode.

term.description: Parliamentary term 0–10; adopted_texts and committee search only.

text.description: Adopted-texts-only keyword search in the requested language.

title.description: Adopted-texts-only title search in the requested language.

work_type.description: Search-only family-specific code from euparl_list_reference topic document_types; case-insensitive and whitespace-trimmed.

year.description: Four-digit document year; adopted_texts and plenary search only.

name: euparl_search_documents

appliedFilters.description: Actual normalized retrieval scope and filters.

available.description: Whether the selected source array was published, including a published empty array.

document.description: Present only when get finds published detail.

adopted_document_ids.description: Explicit adopted document relations in published order; targets can be retrieved with mode get but may be unavailable upstream.

based_on_document_ids.description: Explicit based-on document relations in published order; no procedure relationship is inferred.

creator_ids.description: All published creator references, without inferred authorship.

document_id.description: Canonical work identifier accepted by document get regardless of family.

label.description: Exact published label, when available in the catalogue.

links.description: Every source-file link in the selected expression language, preserving metadata.

size_bytes.description: Published byte size retained as a decimal string.

parent_document_ids.description: Explicit parent documents; retrieve with this tool in get mode when a subdivision lacks files.

procedure_ids.description: Procedure IDs from explicit source relationships; use euparl_get_procedure.

public_register_ref.description: Published public-register notation, preserved verbatim; absent when unpublished.

source_url.description: Public linked-data source URL for this work.

title.description: Published title and its actual selected language.

language.description: Actual language of the published text.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `invalid_filter`: A code, identifier, language, date range or source-specific filter is unsupported, or adopted-text offset plus effective limit exceeds the 10000-result search window. `invalid_mode_fields`: Get lacks document_id, mixes search filters, or uses nondefault paging; search supplies document_id. `upstream_rejected`: Parliament rejects validated request parameters. `upstream_rate_limited`: Parliament rate limits persist after bounded retries. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

found.description: Get-only publication result; false for missing or empty detail.

items.description: Whole sparse records on a search page; absent in get mode.
Sparse document discovery record; title and dates require detail retrieval.

document_id.description: Canonical work identifier accepted by document get regardless of family.

label.description: Exact published label, when available in the catalogue.

source_url.description: Public linked-data source URL for this work.

notice.description: Publication, language fallback, empty-result or continuation guidance.

page.description: Search continuation metadata; absent in get mode.

has_more.description: Whether more matches are known or cannot be ruled out; a search window may prevent continuation.

limit.description: Effective whole-item page size, at most 100.

next_offset.description: Usable next offset when continuation is accessible; absent at a search-window boundary even if has_more is true.

offset.description: Zero-based position in the selected collection.

returned.description: Number of complete items on this page.

snapshot.description: Digest of the complete normalized local collection and scope; reuse for continuation.

shown.description: Whole items shown on this partial page.

source.description: Effective family in search mode; absent in generic get.

totalCount.description: Exact count only when published or computed over a complete collection.

truncated.description: True when this page returns only part of the selected collection.
